layout.feature: Single set reference@6; native feature type@17 Rule1/FullRound2; rolling-ball property@21; owned proxy@37 repeated in exact source/parameter dependency table@127.
layout.FullRound: Set58 bytes with proxy@32. A9D aggregate ->128CC leaf48: automatic byte2; single source lists@3/18/33, references@7/22/37 are sideOne/sideTwo/center. Each typed4C68 source53 stores opaque pair and face-point cache before its bounded-face recipe reference@42.
layout.Rule: Constant set68 has radius binding@44, native rule@55 and topology@64. Asymmetric78 has offsets@12/@23, native rule@65/topology@74. Native rule2/1 maps API AllEdges0/Between1; topology3/2/1 maps API Both0/Rounds1/Fillets2.
layout.selector: 8484 selector10 bytes repeats API topology u32@2; u32@6 is feature mode2 or face mode0. Repeated topology must agree with set control.
layout.AllEdges_source: 5E1E leaf36: two empty face groups and one typed90055 feature identity leaf; explicit native Extrude source must agree with aggregate support owner. Historical body anchor remains original seed owner, distinct from selected Boss feature.
layout.Between_roles: 5E1E leaf47: first recipe@6 is API source_two; final recipe@36 is API source_one; middle list empty. Reversal corroborated by actual swapped-role getters and byte-identical FullRound center/side recipes; no coordinate matching chooses identity.
layout.contexts: Full3 C46 contexts; Rule55-byte50AEE cache lists observed lengths12/8/4 for AllEdges Both/Rounds/Fillets,1 Between. They remain opaque and are not input counts or persistent selected edges.

limitations: Only captured one-set FullRound, one-Extrude AllEdges, or one-face-per-group Between constant/asymmetric layouts.
Face point caches match rectangular-face centroid/pointOnFace in the swapped FullRound holdout; general centroid semantics and first opaque pair remain unresolved.
Typed bounded-face recipes retain source provenance; persistent face/edge IDs, trimmed topology, context transforms and fillet regeneration unresolved.

Actual result face/edge counts, volumes, health and warning are API observations only, not reconstructed geometry.
